Where the numbers come from
API windows, azimuth, p_success: POST /v1/windows. Site and corridor: GET /v1/site.
Ephemeris the ascent arc is drawn only when GET /v1/orbits/{id}/ephemeris starts at the pad at liftoff.
Drawn globe rotation, Sun position and wedge length are scene rendering, not engine output.
